tools.name: search_coverage
tools.description: Free: find a covered company, central bank or US macro release by name or topic. Returns the tool to call. Missing? Use request_data.

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: Free: cards changed since a date, with content_hash so you skip re-buying unchanged cards. Missing coverage? Use request_data.

tools.name: sample_delta
tools.description: Free sample of get_filing_delta for any covered ticker: same schema, no payment. Use it to test before paying. Tickers: AMD, MRVL, NVDA, AVGO, TSM, MU, AMAT, AAPL, MSFT, META, TSLA, ORCL, INTC, ASML, MSTR, JPM, BAC, GS, WFC, NFLX, JNJ, BRK, PLTR, SPCX.

tools.name: sample_policy
tools.description: Free sample rate-decision card for any covered central bank: the previous meeting, same schema as get_policy, no payment. Policy ids: BOE, FED, ECB, BOJ, RBA, BOC, SNB, NOR, SWE, MEX, BOK, TUR, IND, ZAF, CHN, IDN, ETH, RUS, EGY, IRN, BCB.

tools.name: sample_macro
tools.description: Free sample US macro card (CPI, payrolls, GDP): a trimmed view of the latest card (comparison_basis says how many items), same schema as get_macro, no payment. Macro ids: NFP, GDP, CPI.

tools.name: get_filing_delta
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC on Base. Call when you need what changed in a company's latest SEC filing (10-Q, 10-K, 8-K or 6-K) vs the prior period, not the headline: each change cited to EDGAR with a materiality rating and why it matters. Free: sample_delta. Tickers: AMD, MRVL, NVDA, AVGO, TSM, MU, AMAT, AAPL,

tools.name: request_data
tools.description: Free: ask for a ticker, bank or release we lack. what required (500 chars max), no links/HTML. Limit 5/hour, 20/wallet/day. Returns ok.

tools.name: get_policy
tools.description: Paid $0.02 USDC on Base. Call when you need the latest central-bank rate decision (hike, hold or cut) for a major or emerging-market bank: policy rate, change in bps, vote, next meeting and official source. Free: sample_policy. Policy ids: BOE, FED, ECB, BOJ, RBA, BOC, SNB, NOR, SWE, MEX, BOK, TUR,

tools.name: get_macro
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC on Base. Call when you need the latest US CPI, nonfarm payrolls or GDP release as cited items with the official source. Free: sample_macro. Macro ids: NFP, GDP, CPI. Others return 404 (no charge).

tools.name: get_cpi
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC on Base. Call when you need the latest inflation (CPI or HICP) print for a covered country or area, with headline, core and selected categories, each item cited to the statistics office. Free: sample_macro id CPI (US). CPI ids: US, UK, EA, JP. Others return 404 (no charge).
